summary: Rank-local CSR data is processed by the vector kernel selected from the local average nonzero count. The timed runtime loop calls the selector/launcher and synchronizes before retrieving local rows. All six compiled group-size SASS variants are present and each uses row guards, nonzero traversal, reduction and stores.

source_evidence.claim: Selector covers 1/2/4/8/16/32 groups; rank-local row/CSR setup and timed launcher loop.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked loop dispatches one of the group-size launchers per iteration and synchronizes after repetitions.
